subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should the WebChat send-shortcut preference live in scoped browser UiSettings, in gateway/openclaw.json config, or be declined in favor of the current Enter-to-send behavior?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested preference, but adding any persisted setting creates product and compatibility surface; the linked PR already shows this needs owner/scope approval before implementation can land cleanly.

options.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
options.body: Add a browser-local but gateway-scoped Control UI preference, keep Enter-to-send as the default, route copy through i18n, and cover Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, and persistence in tests.

options.title: Add Gateway Config
options.body: Introduce a documented gateway/openclaw.json setting only if maintainers want operators to control the shortcut across clients despite the current WebChat no-config docs direction.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior
options.body: Decline the preference and leave plain Enter as the only send shortcut, with duplicates remaining closed and this issue closed by maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
recommendation.body: Add a browser-local but gateway-scoped Control UI preference, keep Enter-to-send as the default, route copy through i18n, and cover Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, and persistence in tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review comments and recent WebChat docs/config-scope history make this the clearest owner for the product-scope choice.
